lead_welcome.name: bb_re_welcome
lead_welcome.body: Hi {{1}}, thanks for enquiring with {{2}} 🏡. I'm the assistant — tap *Book site visit* and I'll shortlist homes for your budget, or *Call me* for an advisor.

day_before.body: Hi {{1}}, your site visit with {{2}} is tomorrow ({{3}}) at {{4}} in {{5}}. Reply *1* to confirm or *2* to reschedule. Free pick-up available.

two_hours.body: Hi {{1}}, your {{2}} site visit is at {{3}} today. Our advisor will call you 30 minutes before. 📍 {{4}}

after_visit.body: Hi {{1}}, thanks for visiting with {{2}}. Shall we share the price sheet, floor plans and home-loan estimate for {{3}}? Reply *Yes* and we'll send them.

winback.body: Hi {{1}}, new launch prices are out at {{2}}. Reply *Details* for the latest {{3}} options in your budget.

owner_report.body: Daily update from BotBhai: {{1}}. Reply to this message to see the full report.

refer.name: bb_re_refer
refer.body: Hi {{1}}, thanks for choosing {{2}}! 🙌 Know someone who'd love it too? Share your code {{3}}: they get a free home-loan check, and so do you on your next visit. They just message us the code on WhatsApp.
